end.summary:
- Discussed naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
- Identified a rocket’s pointed nose as a cone and middle section as a cylinder.
- Identified rocket fins as triangle-like and a ball as a sphere.
- Practised cylinder faces; said it has two flat faces.
- Mixed up whether an upside-down cone keeps its name; this was not corrected by the end.
end.parentNote: Aditya practised naming 3D shapes using parts of a rocket, a candle, and a ball. They used the pointed tip to identify a cone, the middle section to identify a cylinder, and the ball to identify a sphere; they also counted two flat faces on a cylinder. Aditya mixed up whether turning a cone changes its shape name, and this was not corrected by the end. At home, turn toy objects around together and ask, “Does its shape name change?”
